request.style: English, male voice, warm and resonant solo, acoustic guitar, upright bass, light percussion, cello, contemplative and building, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A blind and mute man was brought to Him
Jesus healed him so he could speak and see
The crowds were amazed by what they saw
Could this be the Son of David?

[Pre-Chorus]
But Pharisees heard and spoke with scorn
Said He drives out demons by Beelzebul
They doubted the power at work in Him
And questioned the spirit of God's will

[Chorus]
Every kingdom divided falls apart
No city or house will stand alone
If Satan casts out Satan then he is split
His kingdom cannot remain

[Verse]
He knew their thoughts and answered clear
Who drives out demons by Beelzebul
Then by whom do your people drive them out
They will be the judges of you

[Chorus]
Every kingdom divided falls apart
No city or house will stand alone
If Satan casts out Satan then he is split
His kingdom cannot remain

[Pre-Chorus]
But if I drive out demons by Spirit of God
Then the kingdom of God has come upon you
He ties up the strong man to take his goods
And plunders the house of the enemy

[Chorus]
Every kingdom divided falls apart
No city or house will stand alone
If Satan casts out Satan then he is split
His kingdom cannot remain

[Bridge]
Whoever is not with me is against me
Whoever does not gather scatters away
Every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven
But not the blasphemy against the Spirit

[Outro]
Speak against the Son of Man and be forgiven
Speak against the Holy Spirit and not
Either in this age or in the age to come
The Kingdom has come upon you
